item.title: Daily digest — 2026-08-02
item.description:
Our open-source research community has seen exciting progress across multiple projects. The `tenzing` and `scrutiny` projects have both received updates to their GitHub pages sites, with `tenzing` releasing version 0.4.1 and `scrutiny` deploying new content twice. Meanwhile, the `oddpub` project has enhanced its ontogenerator with "nature das and cas detection" capabilities, and the `auto-zcurve` project has made significant strides in addressing compatibility and portability issues, introducing an extraction schema, and switching to a browser-based UI. These updates demonstrate the community's commitment to improving and expanding their tools, and we celebrate the connections between these projects as they work together to advance open-source research. Notably, the focus on compatibility and user experience in `auto-zcurve` and the updates to `tenzing` and `scrutiny` highlight the community's dedication to creating accessible and user-friendly tools.

27 commits across 5 active repositories this week.

New releases: auto-zcurve v0.11.0

Dormant repos revived: scrutiny, escicheck, auto-zcurve

item.title: auto-zcurve: 5 commits today
item.description:
shaheedazaad/auto-zcurve

The `main` branch was the focus of the recent work, with multiple commits addressing various aspects of the project. The first commit addressed "windows compatibility issues", indicating that changes were made to resolve problems related to running the project on Windows. Another commit tackled "portability issues", suggesting that modifications were made to enhance the project's ability to run seamlessly across different environments. Additionally, an "extraction schema" was introduced, which likely refers to a new or updated method for extracting data, and the project's "readme" was updated, presumably to reflect the recent changes. The project also underwent a significant change with the switch to a "browser-based UI", which altered the user interface to be accessed through a web browser.
